_purpose: Owner-marked clean HALF-route segments (#420). Each cut hand-EXCLUDES trick jumps so movement quality is measured without trick-execution contamination. Source for build_route_canon.py -> route_canon.dm3.json.
_demo_note: demo alias 'book_vs_mix[dm3].mvd' = hub 129232 (mix 243-172 Book). Clock = match-relative mm:ss, ZERO offset on pos.t. Decode: qw-analyze -view full -include positions,view,velocity. The --analysis KEY must equal the `demo` alias here (alias-to-alias, not real-filename resolution).
_route_class_note: base|shortcut|enabler per #420. seg4/seg5 classes are owner-confirmable defaults; reclassifying edits this field only (ids are slug(label), decoupled from class).
_end_marker_note: Optional per-BASE-mark `end_marker` (#460): the 1-based live FBMARKER index nearest the half-route END (end_xyz), used as the directed-eval goal pin (k_fb_moveprobe_fixed_goal_s<edict>) so the handoff gate latches each bot onto its highway. NEAREST-ANY marker (not nearest goal-item): fixed_goal accepts any marker and the gate only needs the goal origin within MHW_R_GOAL=256qu (2-D) of the END; for rl_high_bridge_window_lifts the nearest goal-item (Ring) is 406qu out -> only a path marker engages. Indices are dm3-matchless-deterministic (item 1-65 from BSP, path 66-299 from dm3.bot, verified 234/234). build_route_canon passes it through; route_eval validates (positive 1-based int).
